description: The agent must: (1) Read the character backstory files for Elena Reyes and Marco Vitelli from the project directory. (2) Produce character_psychology_brief.md containing two full psychological profiles and one relationship dynamics analysis. (3) Each profile MUST follow the SKILL.md schema: Big Five traits with behavioral manifestations, one of the four specific attachment types (安全型/焦虑-迷恋型/回避-疏离型/恐惧-回避型), defense mechanisms categorized under Vaillant's hierarchy specifically, core trauma, coping strategies, and blind spots. (4) The relationship dynamics section MUST include 'unspoken contracts' (无言契约) — a proprietary schema element that generic agents unfamiliar with this SKILL.md will omit — along with power dynamics classification, communication patterns, specific triggers, and growth edges. (5) The document must cite at least 4 named theoretical frameworks (e.g., Bowlby, Beck, Vaillant, Karpman Drama Triangle) and must acknowledge the cultural/contextual limitations of those frameworks. (6) Both adaptive strengths AND maladaptive patterns must be present for each character. (7) Characters must never be reduced to diagnostic labels. The key proprietary trap is the 'unspoken contracts' requirement and the Vaillant defense hierarchy categorization — generic agents will describe defenses generically without the hierarchical classification, and will likely omit the unspoken contracts schema element entirely.
